value.rationale: For a canonical combinatorial integer sequence whose binary parity and zero-run structure were published in 2026, the exact first nonzero valuation shell is a natural, previously uncomputed invariant. Its exact mod-four population and doubled-pole growth capture the transition immediately above parity, with a diverging logarithmic relative density and a contrast to the empty shell of binom(3n,n). This is not a finite-table increment or an arbitrary index slice; it provides an all-scale arithmetic refinement of a motivated unsolved boundary. No higher-shell or general-arities theorem is claimed.
